content.title: IBD Stock Of The Day: Buy Points In Play As Oil Refinery Margins Fatten
content.summary: The Findlay, Ohio-based oil refiner is IBD's Stock of the Day for Friday.  Marathon, like most oil refineries, is helped by the growing difference between crude oil prices, which are going down, and gas prices, which have stayed flat.  The difference between inputs and the refined products companies like Marathon sell is referred to in the oil business as the "crack spread."
